extra_misconceptions.fact: Intact blister skin forms a sterile barrier against bacteria, so keep it unpopped and protect the area with a moleskin doughnut pad.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Popping a friction blister on the heel with a pin speeds up skin healing before the next game.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Early heat dilates blood vessels and worsens bleeding into tissues, whereas cold application for twenty minutes limits acute swelling.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Applying a heating pad immediately to a fresh ankle sprain reduces joint swelling and internal bruising.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Most concussions occur without any loss of consciousness and present through dizziness, confusion, headache, or sensitivity to light.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Athletes must lose consciousness during a collision to suffer a sports-related concussion.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Scrubbing the root destroys periodontal ligament cells needed for reattachment; handle only the crown and transport the tooth in cold milk.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Scrubbing a knocked-out permanent tooth root with soap and water removes dirt safely before reinsertion.

extra_socratic_questions: Which physical indicator distinguishes a ligament sprain at an ankle joint from a muscle or tendon strain?
Why is it dangerous to allow an athlete with suspected concussion symptoms to return to play on the same day?
What happens to core body temperature regulation when an athlete stops sweating during high-heat exertion?
Where should a Scout place an avulsed permanent tooth if it cannot be gently reinserted into its socket?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Rapid adolescent growth spurts and new family cardiac history require an updated annual screening to clear an athlete for heavy exertion.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Passing last year's school checkup eliminates the need for a pre-participation sports physical before a new season.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Nicotine in smokeless tobacco constricts blood vessels, raises resting heart rate and blood pressure, and causes oral cancer and gum loss.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Smokeless chewing tobacco avoids lung damage and therefore has no negative effect on athletic stamina or reaction time.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Fats and heavy proteins digest slowly and divert blood flow to the stomach; eat complex carbohydrates three to four hours before competition.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Eating a large high-fat steak thirty minutes before kickoff provides rapid fuel for sprinting on the field.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Non-prescribed steroids fuse adolescent growth plates prematurely, damage the liver and heart, and cause severe hormonal and mood disorders.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Anabolic steroids build muscle mass safely in teen athletes as long as the athlete lifts heavy weights daily.

extra_socratic_questions: Which hidden cardiovascular or musculoskeletal conditions can a pre-participation physical exam detect before training begins?
What happens to red blood cell oxygen transport when carbon monoxide from smoking or vaping enters the bloodstream?
Under what condition does pre-competition carbohydrate loading improve muscle glycogen stores for endurance events?
Why is it dangerous to rely on caffeinated energy drinks or alcohol before or after intense athletic competition?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Stretching cold muscles reduces power output and risks micro-tears; perform light aerobic activity and dynamic movements before static holds.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Holding cold static stretches for sixty seconds before warming up is the safest way to prepare muscles for sprinting.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Properly programmed resistance training strengthens connective tissues, improves joint stability, and increases running and swimming economy.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Weight training is only useful for football linemen and bodybuilders because it makes endurance athletes muscle-bound.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Muscle fibers repair and grow stronger during recovery periods between sessions, so training the same muscle group daily causes overtraining.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Lifting the heaviest possible barbell weight every single day builds athletic strength faster than scheduled rest days.

extra_misconceptions.fact: True sportsmanship requires respecting officials, opponents, and teammates before, during, and after every practice and contest, win or lose.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Good sportsmanship only applies to shaking hands with opponents after your team wins a close championship game.

extra_socratic_questions: What happens to blood pooling in the lower extremities if a sprinter stops abruptly at the finish line without a cool-down?
Which physiological change during a dynamic warm-up prepares muscle fibers and synovial joints for explosive movement?
Where does the boundary lie between an amateur athlete's permissible expense reimbursement and professional compensation?
What specific action by a team captain after a controversial referee call demonstrates Scout spirit to both teams?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Each selected sport requires structured training, rule mastery, and participation in an official season or three-month approved training plan.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Playing informal backyard pickup basketball with friends satisfies the organized competition requirement for this badge.

extra_misconceptions.fact: You must discuss your two sport choices with your counselor first to verify how you will fulfill every sub-requirement for both activities.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Completing requirements for both baseball and softball counts as two completely separate sports without counselor review.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Both bowling and table tennis are official options on the approved list and require a three-month training log and technical skill checks.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Sports that are not played on a traditional rectangular field, such as bowling or table tennis, are ineligible choices.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Requirement 4 mandates discussing how you will complete requirements 5a through 5h for both selected sports with your counselor at the outset.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Starting the three-month training chart before meeting with a merit badge counselor guarantees automatic approval later.

extra_socratic_questions: Which scheduling factors should you verify before pairing two seasonal sports to complete a three-month training plan?
Under what condition does selecting two sports with overlapping muscle demands increase your risk of overuse injury?
What facility access and protective gear must be confirmed with your counselor before committing to an ice or water sport?
Where will you find an organized league, school team, or sanctioned competition to fulfill the match play requirements?

extra_misconceptions.fact: An effective training chart records specific drills, workout durations, measurable performance benchmarks, and personal development over time.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Checkmarks showing practice dates on a calendar are enough to satisfy the three-month athletic training log requirement.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Official rules govern legal play and carry game penalties, while etiquette covers unwritten standards of courtesy, fairness, and player safety.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Sport etiquette and official game rules are identical concepts enforced with the same foul or penalty by referees.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Damaged impact shells lose their ability to disperse collision forces and must be replaced or reconditioned by a certified technician.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Cracked polycarbonate helmet shells or frayed racket strings can be safely repaired with duct tape for tournament play.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Your playing area diagram must accurately depict key dimensions, zones, goal or net placements, and player positions for each selected sport.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Drawing a rough rectangle without boundary lines or court measurements fulfills the playing area diagram requirement.

extra_socratic_questions: What measurement confirms that your three-month training chart tracks progressive skill development rather than attendance?
Which boundary dimensions, penalty zones, and scoring areas must appear on an accurate diagram of your playing surface?
Why is it dangerous to store sweat-soaked protective pads and helmets inside a closed gear bag between practices?
What happens to a player's penalty status when violating unwritten sport etiquette versus breaking an official rulebook law?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Certified athletic trainers are allied healthcare professionals who require an accredited degree, clinical hours, and board exam certification.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Certified athletic trainers and weekend gym personal trainers hold the same medical credentials and clinical licensing.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Thousands of sports careers exist in sports medicine, officiating, coaching, facility management, biomechanics, and athletic communications.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Professional athlete is the only viable career path for someone who wants to work full-time in the sports industry.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Sanctioned officials must register with state associations, pass annual rule exams, attend field clinics, and buy required uniform equipment.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Former varsity athletes can officiate sanctioned high school games immediately without passing background or rule exams.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Masters leagues, municipal recreation clubs, and officiating associations let adults stay active and connected to their sport for a lifetime.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Competing in sports ends permanently after graduation unless an athlete wins a collegiate scholarship or pro contract.

extra_socratic_questions: Which national board certification and accredited degree must an athletic trainer earn before treating injured athletes?
What ongoing expenses and recertification hours should a sports official budget for beyond initial rulebook testing?
Under what condition does joining a regional adult club or national governing body improve lifelong sport participation?
What happens to your long-term joint health when you adapt high-impact youth sports into low-impact adult recreation?
